entities.summary: Rhea Margaret Norwood is an English actress. She is best known for her role as Imogen Heaney in the Netflix teen series Heartstopper (2022–present). She also appeared in the Channel 4 drama Consent (2023) and the Amazon Prime comedy Your Christmas or Mine 2 (2023).
